ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 dated 15 December 2022 (effective 1 March 2023); Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP dated 28 April 2023 providing for the implementation of the AML Law; Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 dated 17 June 2020 (effective 1 January 2021); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration dated 4 January 2021, as amended by Decree No. 91/2023/ND-CP; Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN of the State Bank of Vietnam detailing AML measures for credit institutions and intermediary payment services; Decision No. 397/QD-NHNN promulgating the list of countries/territories with high money-laundering risk (updated 2024).
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (Viet Nam maintains no fully public UBO register; beneficial ownership declarations are submitted to the enterprise registrar and made available to national authorities, including the State Bank of Vietnam and the Financial Intelligence Unit, Ministry of Public Security; the members/legal representative names of an LLC are disclosed in the public enterprise registry, but the AML/CFT beneficial owner analysis is treated as confidential governmental information and not publicly searchable).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign shareholder/investor (e.g., parent company certificate from its home jurisdiction)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registrar of the foreign investor's jurisdiction (e.g., ACRA, Companies House, Delaware Division of Corporations, or the Sokranna of the relevant country)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the competent authority of the foreign state (Viet Nam acceded to the Hague Apostille Convention with effect from 1 October 2014); if the foreign state is not a Hague Convention Party, full consular legalization through the relevant Embassy/Consulate of Viet Nam

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Corporate Existence of the parent shareholder (issued within 30 days prior to apostille)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home jurisdiction company registry or equivalent authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, absent Apostille membership, consular legalization at the Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate with jurisdiction over the foreign state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Constitutional Documents (Charter, By-laws) of the foreign shareholder, including the capital contribution and power of attorney resolution for establishing a Vietnamese LLC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign company's statutory body (board/resolution) and notarization in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, where the Apostille Convention does not apply, consular legalization followed by certified Vietnamese notarized translation in Viet Nam

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Full notarized passport copies of the proposed Legal Representative / Director and the Ultimate Beneficial Owner(s) of the Vietnamese LLC (each page, color)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the respective nationality, followed by apostille or consular legalization of the notarized photocopies in the country of issue
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, then certified Vietnamese notarized translation at a licensed Vietnamese notary public office

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter / Evidence of Financial Capacity of the foreign investor (stating the account relationship, minimum opening balance, and beneficial owner signatories; issued within 3 months) and foreign bank draft or escrow confirmation for capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank in the foreign investor's jurisdiction (signature authenticated by the bank's compliance officer)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille on the bank's notarized certificate of signature or full consular legalization if the issuer is in a non-Apostille jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing a Vietnamese corporate service agent or law firm to act as the enterprise registration representative for the LLC incorporation dossier
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Duly authorized officer of the foreign parent company and/or ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized in the foreign state, then Hague Apostille (or consular legalization), followed by Vietnamese notarized translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory Customer Due Diligence (CDD) under Article 10-15 of Law No. 14/2022/QH15, requiring the licensed corporate service provider or the LLC's legal counsel to screen all applicants (legal entity shareholders, general directors, legal representatives, and every Ultimate Beneficial Owner at the 25% threshold) against the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the State Bank of Vietnam's domestic blacklist of organized crime/terrorism financing (promulgated by the Financial Intelligence Unit of the Ministry of Public Security), and the Foreign Terrorist Organizations (FTO) list; enhanced due diligence (EDD) and source-of-funds verification is mandatory for any Politically Exposed Person (PEP), high-risk jurisdiction connected party, or any name appearing on any sanctions list; a negative screening report must be retained for at least 5 years post-incorporation in accordance with Article 19 of the AML Law.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (Cổng Thông tin Quốc gia về Đăng ký Doanh nghiệp) — official website: dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn (operated by the Agency for Business Registration under the Ministry of Planning and Investment).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Articles 38-41 of the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP, the enterprise name must be expressed in Vietnamese script (Vietnamese letters plus allowed digits and special symbols); a Vietnamese legal name must be distinct and not transliterated in a confusingly identical manner; the name may be accompanied by the English name in parentheses, e.g., 'CÔNG TY TNHH GENESIS IMAGE' (Genesis Image LLC); a foreign element is permitted only if transliterated into Vietnamese phonetics and reflected in Latin/Vietnamese script; the trade scope 'commercial stock photo and generative AI visual assets' does not require a license token, but a plain descriptive word indicating the business area ('Ảnh', 'Hình ảnh', 'Photo', 'Media') is recommended for legal transparency.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names identical to those of any other registered enterprise in Viet Nam (nationwide scope of the National Enterprise Registration Portal)
Names confusingly similar to those of foreign enterprises

State/Governmental words: 'Bộ', 'Chính phủ', 'Nhà nước', 'Quốc gia', 'Quốc tế', 'Cộng hòa', 'Xã hội chủ nghĩa', 'Việt Nam' when used as a leading sovereign denomination without ministerial authorization
Armed forces and security tokens: 'Quân đội', 'Công an', 'Bộ đội', 'Vũ trang', 'Tổng cục', 'Dân quân tự vệ'

Misleading financial/regulated tokens representing banking, securities, insurance, or collective investment in the absence of a license: 'Ngân hàng', 'Chứng khoán', 'Bảo hiểm', 'Quỹ đầu tư', 'Tín dụng'
Judicial/religious/political tokens: 'Toà án', 'Viện Kiểm sát', 'Thi hành án', 'Tòa Thánh', 'Giáo hội', 'Đảng Cộng sản', 'Mặt trận Tổ quốc'
Obscene, pejorative, or defamatory words contrary to Vietnamese cultural custom
The exact official names of state agencies, unitary people's committees, public nonprofit units, or names of famous national heroes without presidential or ministerial endorsement
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon receipt of a name rejection notice from the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) (within 5-7 working days of online filing), the applicant may first revise and resubmit the name as an amended electronic dossier through the same portal without penalty. If the DPI formally refuses issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate, an administrative complaint may be lodged with the Director of the DPI within 30 days of receiving the refusal under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13; the DPI must issue a resolution within 10 working days of full dossier receipt; an unsuccessful complainant may then pursue a first-instance administrative court petition at the Provincial People's Court within 30 days of the DPI's final resolution, citing Article 30 of the Law on Administrative Procedures No. 93/2015/QH14. During the pendency of any appeal, the corporate name reservation is frozen administratively and the statutory 30-day reservation window is automatically suspended if the appellant has timely filed the complaint, per the practice of the Agency for Business Registration.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as a pure mail-drop virtual address. Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP requires the registered office to be a physical premises lawfully used for business purposes in Viet Nam, with an address verifiable by the DPI; however, a serviced office or co-working lease contract (e.g., Regus, Toong, VNO) with a physical desk and meeting room is accepted as satisfying the physical office requirement. For an ISIC 7420 stock photo / AI visual asset platform with payment rails Stripe/PayPal, the DPIs of Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City have, in practice, required a minimum 12-month lease and an executed serviced-office arrangement; a virtual mailbox or shared address with no active occupancy documentation will be rejected and may be administratively cancelled by the registry. The use of a transaction coordinator's office is discouraged, as tax authorities frequently reject it when applying the permanent establishment and commercial substance standard under Circular No. 96/2015/TT-BTC.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate likelihood: 30% probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection within the first 18 months of operation. The likelihood rises to 55% if the registered address is a residential apartment, if the entity has no dedicated separate signage, or, if the tax authority verifies a mismatch between the declared used law and actual presence. The risk is lower (10-15%) for a serviced-office in a Grade A commercial tower with a properly executed lease, furnished workspace, and the legal representative's physical name sign.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the provincial/city in which the LLC is incorporated (e.g., Hanoi DPI / HCMC DPI)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille / consular legalization fee for foreign corporate documents (6 documents) through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Viet Nam
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Socialist Republic of Vietnam), 2 Le Quang Dao, Nam Tu Liem, Hanoi
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of VND 500,000 (approx. USD 20) per document per Circular No. 285/2016/TT-BTC levying fees for consular legalization and apostille services; USD 120 covers the six mandatory documents in the bundle.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Vietnamese notarized translation of all apostilled foreign documents (courtesy translation by licensed Vietnamese translator and notary public)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Notary Public Office (Phòng Công chứng) and certified translation company in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of USD 4-8 per page plus notary fee of VND 500,000 (USD 20) per notarial act; estimated at 40 pages of legal documents.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preparation and submission of the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) application as a 100% foreign-owned LLC (required for non-resident shareholders per Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Management Board of Industrial Zones / Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) — depending on the registered address
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing fee of VND 150,000 (approx. USD 6); the remaining amount reflects the professional service fee charged by authorized corporate service agents for assembling the application, drafting the investment project description, and supporting documentation, which is a prevailing market benchmark of USD 250-400 in Hanoi/HCMC.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Digital signature, corporate electronic seal and tax code e-filing activation (required for VAT certification and online tax declaration)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified digital signature provider (e.g., Viettel, VNPT, BKAV - accredited under Decree No. 130/2018/ND-CP) and the provincial Tax Department
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: VND 1,500,000-3,000,000 (USD 60-120) for annual USB token of the legal representative and the tax authority's statutorily free registration of a new tax code.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO, PEP, and international sanctions screening via commercial compliance database (e.g., Freedom-View, Dow Jones or Equifax risk) covering all beneficial owners and the legal representative, with AML/CDD file retention
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Third-party anti-money-laundering screening data provider and the licensed Vietnamese corporate compliance service provider maintaining the AML file under Law No. 14/2022/QH15 and Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of USD 150-300 for a one-time comprehensive negative-media, PEP, OFAC, UN, EU sanctions, and World Bank debarment screening bundle of up to 5 individuals/entities.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises 2020 (No. 59/2020/QH14), Articles 24-29, 44-48, 62-79; Law on Investment 2020 (No. 61/2020/QH14), Articles 30, 38, 39; Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP on investment registration; Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHDT on national enterprise registration information system.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh) under the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the city/province where the registered office is located; online processing through the National Business Registration Portal (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn). Foreign investment projects are also registered via the National Information System for Foreign Investment (https://fdi.gov.vn).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) pursuant to Form 1 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP; with respect to foreign-owned enterprises an Investment Registration Certificate (Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký đầu tư) is a mandatory antecedent document.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Vietnam Law on Enterprises imposes no statutory minimum paid-up capital for an ordinary LLC (non-licensed sector); the charter capital is declared at the member's discretion and must be contributed within 90 days after the Enterprise Registration Certificate date. No escrow account or bank freeze is required under national law for an LLC unless the project is subject to investment conditions listed in the Investment Law. A foreign-invested entity must maintain the total investment capital as stated in the Investment Registration Certificate; paid-up capital is disclosed in the dossier but no minimum threshold applies for ISIC 7420.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế), Ministry of Finance, Socialist Republic of Viet Nam — National electronic tax portal: etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn; e-invoice portal: hoahoadon.gdt.gov.vn; enterprise registration portal: dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested LLC must first obtain an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment or the applicable industrial zone authority. The enterprise registration dossier concurrently serves as a tax registration application, and the tax authority automatically issues the statutory 10-digit tax identification number (Mã số thuế, MST). The foreign corporate shareholder must appoint a legal representative in Viet Nam, submit the ERC/IRC applications, charter, list of members, notarized constitutional documents, power-of-attorney, and passport evidence. After ERC issuance, the LLC completes the initial tax declaration through the e-tax portal using its MST, activates digital signatures, and files all subsequent corporate income tax and VAT returns under that single national TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — A foreign-invested Limited Liability Company is a resident enterprise subject to Enterprise Income Tax (EIT) at the statutory headline rate of 20% on worldwide taxable income. There is no pass-through treatment under Vietnamese law. Territorial scope is not limited to Vietnamese-source income for resident enterprises, though foreign-source income may be credited for foreign tax paid. A standard LLC without special incentive certification is not deemed tax-exempt; only enterprises established as Export Processing Enterprises (EPE), high-tech enterprises, or in designated investment incentive zones may qualify for temporary/partial tax reductions or exemptions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No IRC Section 7701-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists in Vietnamese tax law. The LLC is a fixed entity-level taxpayer. Available statutory elections and designations include: (i) election to apply the export processing enterprise (EPE) regime for duty/VAT-suspension and export VAT benefits; (ii) application for high-tech enterprise certification or investment incentive certificates for hi-tech/geographic priority zones; (iii) selection of VAT computation method — the credit/deduction method is mandatory for an LLC maintaining complete accounting records; the direct/indirect method is not available to a standard LLC. No separate hybrid-mismatch election or sub-entity classification is permissible.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Thuế Giá trị Gia Tăng, VAT)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic turnover threshold applies to a corporate LLC: VAT registration and invoicing are mandatory from the date of enterprise registration regardless of turnover. Separate to that, an annual revenue threshold of VND 100,000,000 applies only to business households and individual traders, below which they may be exempt from VAT. This household exemption does not extend to a commercial stock-photo LLC operating as a limited liability company.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All enterprises must use the national e-invoice regime (Hóa đơn điện tử, HĐĐT) under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. Every VAT invoice must be issued with a tax authority code, transmitted in real time to the General Department of Taxation through the e-invoice portal at hoahoadon.gdt.gov.vn using digitally signed XML/JSON API templates, and confirmed by the tax authority's digital code/verification number before it is legally usable. The LLC's billing and payment rails (Stripe, PayPal) must be integrated so that each sales transaction generates the prescribed XML schema, applies the correct VAT rate, and transmits invoice clearance data to the tax authority without manual intervention. No paper invoice or unstamped HĐĐT is fiscally valid for a corporate exporter.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rate eligibility applies to exported goods and offshore services delivered and consumed outside Viet Nam. A stock-photo marketplace LLC may apply 0% VAT on digital visual assets and platform services sold to a foreign customer located abroad, provided the supply is not consumed in Viet Nam and the LLC can substantiate an export contract/offshore service agreement, separate invoicing in foreign currency, and settlement through bank remittance from a non-Vietnamese account. Sales to Vietnamese resident customers, even through the same platform, are subject to standard 10% VAT and cannot be zero-rated. If the documentary conditions are not satisfied, the tax authority re-classifies the turnover as domestic taxable supply and imposes 10% VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Tờ khai Hàng hóa Xuất khẩu) — mandatory where physical media or goods enter the export customs process
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill / multimodal transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate (Giấy báo Có ngoại tệ) or bank/FinTech statement evidencing foreign currency settlement
Export sales contract or offshore service agreement with the foreign customer
Electronic VAT invoice (HĐĐT) with tax authority code
Stripe/PayPal payout statements and interfund remittance records linking foreign receipts to the specific zero-rated invoice
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The tax authority may retrospectively verify export zero-rating claims up to five years after the tax filing period. Where an invoice has been zero-rated without full documentary evidence, the authority will revoke the 0% VAT treatment, re-assess turnover at 10%, impose late-payment interest, and recover any unlawfully refunded input VAT. Administrative penalties for false invoice/declaration or tax evasion may range up to three times the evaded tax amount for serious violations, plus statutory penalty interest. In cases involving fabricated customs declarations, false invoices, or proceeds above criminal thresholds, directors may incur criminal liability for tax evasion or smuggling under the Vietnamese Penal Code, including fines, forfeiture, and imprisonment. Clawback immunity is not available after the statutory audit period begins without complete compliance substance.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV / Ngan hang Nha nuoc Viet Nam), functioning as the sole central bank and foreign exchange control authority of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam. FX regulation is exercised primarily through the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange No. 28/2005/PL-UBTVQH11, as amended by Ordinance No. 06/2013/UBTVQH13, Decree No. 70/2014/ND-CP, and Circular No. 06/2019/TT-NHNN, as amended by Circular No. 03/2022/TT-NHNN and Circular No. 23/2023/TT-NHNN. The SBV exclusively authorizes licensed credit institutions to conduct foreign-currency activities; all external treasury operations of VN_LLC must be executed through an SBV-licensed bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Viet Nam maintains a substantially liberalized current-account convertibility regime: cross-border royalties, stock-photo licensing fees, subscription revenue, digital-content download fees, and other service-export receipts may be transferred into Vietnam and repatriated abroad without prior SBV approval, provided the underlying transaction is supported by a genuine commercial contract, invoices, tax records, and is settled through an authorized bank. The capital account remains controlled and licensing-based: foreign equity contributions must be routed through a registered Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA); foreign loans require registration with the State Bank in accordance with applicable thresholds; derivative and hedging transactions require a demonstrable underlying commercial foreign-currency exposure; and no free convertibility exists for speculative, portfolio, or non-documented flows attributable to a non-listed Vietnamese LLC. Profit and dividend remittance by the foreign-invested LLC is not subject to a quantitative cap, but is conditional upon audited annual financial statements, completed enterprise income tax finalization, settlement of all tax and social-insurance liabilities, and bank verification before each outward transfer. Liquidation-capital repatriation additionally requires DICA closure confirmation and a tax clearance certificate.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: All export and service-licensing proceeds arising from foreign customers, including stock-photo download fees, platform subscription receipts, and royalty payments for digital visual-asset licenses, must be repatriated in full into an authorized foreign-currency account or the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) maintained with an SBV-licensed bank. The statutory baseline requires goods-export proceeds to be credited no later than 90 days from the date of exportation, with possible extension under deferred-payment terms up to 180 days; service-export and royalty proceeds must be credited within 180 days from the date the service is completed or the licensing period closes, as represented in the underlying agreement, and the SBV or the servicing bank may grant extensions in meritorious or documented force-majeure cases. The mandatory foreign-currency surrender (compulsory conversion) ratio is currently dormant at zero, meaning exporters are entitled to retain USD, EUR, and other eligible foreign currencies in permitted FX accounts without any State-imposed conversion quota; however, the Government retains the statutory authority to activate mandatory conversion ratios during urgent balance-of-payments emergencies, and the LLC's treasury policy should therefore maintain the ability to demonstrate the source and timing of all foreign-currency inflows.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA), operational VND/USD collection account, and treasury settlement account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam (BIDV)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) and operational VND/FX account with escrow-style capital-utilization capability

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Industry and Trade (VietinBank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) and operational VND/FX settlement account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Technological and Commercial Joint Stock Bank (Techcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational VND/USD collection and treasury-sweep account; DICA capacity available for foreign-invested LLCs

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: MEDIUM-LOW as a primary treasury vehicle, and HIGH only as a peripheral collection aggregator. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise Business, Airwallex, Currenxie, and Payoneer are not licensed by the State Bank of Vietnam as credit institutions or licensed intermediary payment service providers; they cannot lawfully hold the LLC's resident corporate balances, clear VND-denominated payments, issue local account-routing rails, or host the statutory DICA. Under the Law on Credit Institutions No. 32/2024/QH15 and SBV Decree No. 34/2024 on intermediary payment services? Actually the controlling instrument is Decree No. 52/2024/ND-CP governing intermediary payment services, any payment intermediate operating in or serving Vietnamese residents without SBV authorization risks regulatory sanction. Notwithstanding, the LLC may contractually engage foreign EMIs as merchant-of-record or payout aggregators for remote card settlement and global marketplace collections, provided the aggregated proceeds are swept, on a daily or weekly cycle, into a licensed Vietnamese bank account in the name of VN_LLC. All statutory capital contributions, FX conversions, hedging, and corporate treasury settlements must remain onshore at an SBV-licensed bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is MANDATORY for at least one of the following in an in-person meeting at the designated branch in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City: the foreign legal representative, a fully authorized Vietnamese signatory holding a notarized and consular-legalized power of attorney, or the chief financial officer/treasury director. Fully remote opening is NOT permitted for a foreign-invested LLC under Vietnamese Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 19/2022/QH15 and SBV Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN on customer identification and enhanced due diligence. The opening interview requires biometric passport verification, confirmation of the beneficial-ownership structure, disclosure of the business model, and manual signature specimens in the presence of a bank officer. Additional directors or shareholders may be represented by certified copies of identity documents, and a Vietnamese authorized representative may complete the interview in exceptional cases, but bank-level discretion applies; the SBV's risk-based approach treats digital-platform entities with cross-border revenue as subject to enhanced scrutiny, so the LLC should budget for two to three weeks of onboarding time.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity, low-ticket cross-border digital receipts from thousands of micro-end customers settled through Stripe and PayPal, which may resemble unlicensed payment aggregation or third-party beneficiary layering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Payment-processor settlement statements and merchant account records linked to VN_LLC; itemized customer and licensee transaction logs; standard stock-photo licensing terms and platform terms of use; a live commercial website or marketplace storefront evidencing genuine supply of digital visual assets; documented chargeback and refund policy; daily reconciliation reports mapping aggregator sweeps to the Vietnamese operating account; corporate board minutes approving the payment-rail architecture.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity of ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) and intangible-heavy AI-generated content portfolios without clear intellectual-property title, creating suspicion of sanctions exposure, revenue stripping, or undisclosed foreign principals.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UBO registry chart identifying all natural persons owning five percent or more of VN_LLC, with passport copies, proof of address, and birth-name consistency; Investment Registration Certificate and Enterprise Registration Certificate; constitution and shareholder register; certificate of incorporation and good-standing documents; copyright and economic-rights registrations with the Copyright Office of Viet Nam; notarized AI-model licensing agreements and content contributor agreements assigning exploitation rights to the LLC; signed board declarations confirming absence of sanctioned counterparties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recurring payout obligations to a large base of contributing photographers, stock contributors, and AI-licensor third parties, which may be misinterpreted as operating an unlicensed money-service business or shadow-banking scheme.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed photographer and creator agreements with payment schedules and geographic distribution; royalty calculation ledger and automated payout reports; vendor master file with bank account ownership verification; tax identification numbers and withholding-tax schedules for non-resident payees; board-approved payout policy and escrow procedure; SWIFT payment records demonstrating that all outgoing flows correspond to verified contractual counterparties; Vietnamese enterprise income tax and VAT filings reconciling the payout volumes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Thin physical-substance profile, including virtual-office operations and low Vietnamese headcount, that could trigger fraud screens, fabricated-entity flags, or beneficial-ownership intervention.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered lease agreement or long-term co-working license with utility and internet bills in the name of VN_LLC; Vietnamese employment contracts, social-insurance registrations, and payroll reports; AI-training compute and cloud-infrastructure service agreements evidencing local research-and-development leadership; prior-year tax filings and audited financial statements showing real revenue, payroll, and operating expenditure in Viet Nam; director meeting minutes and corporate resolutions demonstrating local management control; photo and video documentation of the registered business premises.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign equity capital injections must be routed via SWIFT MT103 (with MT202 interbank cover legs as appropriate) directly to the VN_LLC Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at the primary licensed relationship bank. The wire's Remittance Information field (field 70) must state the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) number, the phrase 'Foreign Direct Investment — Equity Capital Contribution to VN_LLC', and the equity-transaction reference; the transfer must originate exclusively from the named shareholders' own funded bank accounts, never from third parties, and must be completed within the capital-contribution schedule registered with the IRC, ordinarily within 90 days of IRC issuance unless a longer schedule is approved. The receiving bank will require presentation of the IRC, Enterprise Registration Certificate, charter, DICA registration confirmation, board resolution approving the capital call, UBO declarations, and completion of the SBV's direct-investment data-reporting templates; after verification, the USD capital may be converted to VND at authorized rates and released only for permitted corporate purposes, with full traceability maintained for future dividend and liquidation remittances.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rail for outbound royalty and licensing payments, photographer revenue shares, cloud-computing and AI-infrastructure invoices, and international professional fees is SWIFT MT103 documentary remittance executed through the DICA or operational FX account. Every outgoing credit must be supported by the underlying contract, commercial invoice or royalty statement, applicable Vietnamese withholding-tax certificate, corporate payment authorization, and an accurate purpose code. Domestic Vietnamese dong disbursements for payroll, social insurance, rent, and local vendor invoices are cleared through the NAPAS national retail-payment system and the VND interbank clearing system. Confirmed irrevocable commercial Letters of Credit at sight are reserved exclusively for physical-goods procurements such as computing hardware, camera and studio equipment, and marketing materials, opened through the trade-finance desk of the relationship bank and settled on presentation of transport and title documents. Inbound aggregator settlements from Stripe, PayPal, and Payoneer arrive as USD or EUR sweep wires into the same licensed bank account and are reconciled daily against the platform ledger before onward disbursement to creators and licensors.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable foreign-exchange forward contracts between VN_LLC and an SBV-licensed bank with maximum tenor of 365 days, used to lock USD/VND conversion rates for forecast export royalty inflows and foreign-currency operating expenditures.

FX swaps (spot-forward and forward-forward combinations) permitted under SBV Circular No. 02/2021/TT-NHNN for balance-sheet liquidity bridging between USD and VND without taking speculative positions.

FX options (vanilla calls and puts with up-front premium) exercisable by the LLC against documented underlying commercial exposures such as platform sales, dividend remittance, or foreign creditor repayment.

Cross-currency swap structures against qualifying foreign-currency loan or equity-repatriation exposures, subject to SBV licensing, bank capacity, and the 365-day tenorial ceiling applicable to onshore derivatives.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible onshore as standalone speculative instruments for non-bank corporates; access to offshore NDF markets is restricted and requires an SBV-recognized underlying exposure plus an authorized onshore bank channel. The compliant treasury preference is therefore onshore deliverable forwards and swaps.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Fee Declaration and Payment (Lệ phí môn bài)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direct Tax Office (Chi cục Thuế / Cục Thuế)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 30 January for the current calendar year; newly established entities must pay within 30 days of enterprise registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest at 0.03% per day; administrative penalty up to VND 30,000,000 per Decree 125/2020/ND-CP for failure to file; persistent non-payment can trigger tax debt enforcement, suspension of invoice issuance, and ultimately enterprise registration certificate revocation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Report on Production and Business Situation (Báo cáo tình hình sản xuất kinh doanh)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 calendar days after the end of the fiscal year (by 31 March for a standard calendar year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine from VND 10,000,000 to VND 20,000,000 per Decree 50/2016/ND-CP (as amended by Decree 123/2021/ND-CP); failure to submit for two consecutive fiscal years can result in administrative dissolution/revocation of the Enterprise Registration Certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Investment Project Operation Report (Báo cáo đầu tư năm)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial DPI or Management Board of Industrial/Export Processing Zone, submitted through the National Investment Information System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March each year for the prior calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to VND 10,000,000 per Decree 152/2018/ND-CP for late/non-filing; prolonged non-compliance will blacklist the project and may invalidate the investment registration certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Tax Authority of the enterprise’s domicile (General Department of Taxation via local Tax Office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 calendar days after the end of the fiscal year (by 31 March for calendar-year taxpayers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties up to VND 40,000,000 per Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; late payment interest at 0.03% per day; repeated violations lead to forced tax collection, account freeze, and application of tax administrative enforcement measures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Submission of Audited Annual Financial Statements (Báo cáo tài chính đã kiểm toán)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Tax Office, Provincial DPI, and Statistics Office as applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 calendar days after the end of the fiscal year (by 31 March for calendar-year taxpayers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine from VND 20,000,000 to VND 40,000,000 for failure to submit independent audit report; additionally, inaccurate or non-compliant financial statements may be rejected, triggering re-audit costs and potential tax reassessment penalties.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for all foreign-invested enterprises, regardless of revenue or size; also mandatory for enterprises exceeding total-assets threshold of VND 50 billion, annual revenue of VND 50 billion, or workforce of 300 employees; for this foreign-invested LLC, audit is compulsory by reason of foreign ownership.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) and Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC; IFRS is permitted for consolidated financial statements where the parent company elects to adopt IFRS under MOF regulations.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam has no stand-alone annual UBO declaration to a public registry. The LLC must continuously maintain accurate records of all members and capital contribution as required by the Law on Enterprises 2020. Every share transfer or membership change must be recorded in the Register of Members and reported to the Business Registration Office within 10 days of the change (and to DPI for investment restructuring cases). The annual enterprise report must reflect the updated list of owners; failure to update constitutes an administrative violation punishable under Decree 50/2016/ND-CP.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (including capital contribution and vote rights)
Minute Book (General Meetings and Board Meetings, all resolutions)
Register of Securities or Transfer Log (if any share stakes are transferred)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 – 6,000 per year for a small-scale FDI LLC

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard 20% headline rate; no industry-specific tax holiday for stock-photo or generative visual asset platforms. A preferential 10% CIT rate could only apply if the activity qualified as software product manufacture/services under Decree 125/2016/ND-CP, which is not the ordinary commercial substance of a stock-media marketplace. Limited super-deductions for R&D expenses are available but require prior approval and rigorous cost records.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual CIT finalization: Form 03/TNDN (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN), filed via the General Department of Taxation electronic portal (etax.gdt.gov.vn). Quarterly provisional returns: Form 01/TNDN.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual finalization with quarterly provisional CIT declarations and prepayments
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly: no later than the 30th day of the month immediately following the end of each fiscal quarter. Annual: no later than the 90th day after the fiscal year-end (31 March for a calendar-year taxpayer).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable period, entered as the calendar or fiscal year in YYYY format.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Vietnamese statutory fiscal year; the foreign parent must not report a different period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 13-digit Vietnamese tax identification number of the LLC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Determine the exact code from GDT registration; ensure the legal entity name matches all filings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, registered address, telephone, email and authorized signatory details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders should confirm that a Vietnamese-based legal representative or tax agent is maintained for service of process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: CIT-A / Lợi nhuận kế toán trước thuế
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting profit before tax derived from the audited Vietnamese financial statements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile with the global group consolidation and prepare a VAS/IFRS conversion memorandum.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Additions for non-deductible expenses and taxable revenues not recognized in accounting profit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include additions for excess depreciation, entertainment, bribes or disallowed payments to related parties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reductions for tax-exempt income and any non-taxable adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No treaty dividend exemption should be claimed at CIT line level; treat only as domestic tax law permits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after adjustments (A + B - C).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Positive taxable income must be transferred to computation before loss carryforward.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss carryforward utilized in the current tax period from previous years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses derived under Vietnamese rules may be carried forward for five consecutive years only; retain audited loss schedules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after loss offset; base for CIT computation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must equal the amount multiplied by the applicable CIT rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory or preferential CIT rate percentage; standard 20%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not enter a DTA rate here; DTA rates apply to Vietnamese-source WHT rather than the CIT rate charged to the Vietnam resident LLC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross CIT payable for the year, calculated as taxable income multiplied by the CIT rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile against quarterly provisional payments already made during the year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly prepayments plus foreign tax credits allowed under treaty or domestic law.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credits for taxes paid outside Vietnam are only deductible to the extent a DTA expressly grants such credit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late CIT filing penalties range from VND 2 million to VND 25 million depending on the number of days late and the tax balance; unpaid tax also bears automatic late-payment interest at 0.03% per calendar day. Under-declaration without fraud is penalized at 20% of the additional tax; fraudulent under-declaration can attract 2-3 times the evaded amount plus criminal prosecution when the evaded amount exceeds VND 100 million.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% under Vietnam domestic law for dividends paid to foreign corporate shareholders; no separate dividend withholding tax. Dividends paid to non-resident individuals, however, are subject to personal income tax at 5% unless a DTA provides otherwise.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Beneficial owners seeking DTA reductions on Vietnamese-source royalty, interest or dividend income must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the home jurisdiction, complete Form 01/HTBT and submit it to the Vietnamese tax administration before receiving the payment. The Vietnam LLC must retain an approved dossier, which typically includes ownership legal documents, a declaration of beneficial ownership, and the payer's registration data, and may only apply the reduced WHT after advance/resolution by the GDT.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Under Circular 103/2014/TT-BTC, domestic WHT on royalties is 10% (plus VAT at 5% for cross-border licensing characterized as services) and on interest is 5%. Under DTAs, royalties are typically capped at 10% or 15% and interest at 10% (5% for banks/financial institutions), subject to beneficial ownership and principal purpose tests.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory where total annual revenue exceeds VND 50 billion or aggregate related-party transaction value exceeds VND 30 billion. Master File is required where total annual revenue exceeds VND 200 billion and related-party transaction value exceeds VND 50 billion. All taxpayers with related-party transactions must file TP declaration Forms 01 and 02 with the annual CIT return regardless of the documentation threshold.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vietnam does not maintain a standalone ESR regime for operating companies, but anti-avoidance and substance-over-form rules under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP allow tax authorities to disregard transactions without genuine commercial objectives, real personnel, assets, functions and risk assumption. Treaty-shopping arrangements can be denied relief under the principal purpose test.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission of revenue from stock-photo licensing or AI-generated visual assets, creation of fictitious invoices, overstatement of deductible costs, or fraudulent underpayment of CIT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty of 20% of the under-declared tax (or 2-3 times the tax evaded in serious cases), execution on unpaid tax with 0.03% daily interest, and criminal prosecution under Article 200 of the Penal Code for evasion over VND 100 million, carrying fines up to VND 4.5 billion and imprisonment up to 7 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign, approve or direct false CIT returns are jointly and severally liable; they may face civil restitution, travel bans, asset freezing, and personal imprisonment if their intent is proven.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a nominal-capital LLC with no substantive personnel, premises or management, used primarily to capture treaty benefits or shift profits from digital asset sales.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The GDT may re-characterize transactions, deny treaty benefits, reassess income using deemed profits, and levy additional CIT plus 20% penalty and interest; in egregious abuse, fines can reach triple the avoided tax and the entity may be subject to license revocation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors acting as de facto managers may be personally assessed for the enterprise’s resulting tax liabilities and may face travel bans and confiscation orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Money Laundering via Payment Rails
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using Stripe or PayPal to conceal the true source or beneficial ownership of payments for digital visual assets, or processing funds of unrelated parties without performing customer due diligence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to VND 200 million for violations of the Law on Anti-Money Laundering 2022; criminal liability under Article 324 of the Penal Code carries imprisonment up to 15 years, fines, and confiscation of proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly participate in or fail to prevent laundering transactions are principals; they can be individually fined, imprisoned, banned from leaving the jurisdiction, and ordered to make civil restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare a contemporaneous Local/Master File once thresholds are exceeded, or pricing cross-border sales of AI-generated visual assets to a related party at non-arm's-length rates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax assessment re-adjusting profits to arm's-length results, an additional penalty of 20% of the underpaid tax, and 0.03% daily interest; failure to file documentation may attract fines up to VND 25 million and can elevate to criminal tax evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve group pricing policies and sign legal declarations in Vietnam risk personal liability, including restitution, travel restraints, and criminal investigation if deliberate mispricing is established.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Remitting profits abroad before final CIT finalisation, audited financial statements, and corporate profit distribution procedures are completed, or distributing while the LLC is technically insolvent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The distribution is legally ineffective; regulators can impose administrative penalties up to VND 25 million, require restoration of the distributed amounts, and collect any outstanding CIT plus interest that the distribution was meant to shield.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors must recover distributions for the estate and may be personally liable for the company’s unpaid taxes and creditors if they authorized unlawful dividends.
